items.title: Nasal spray for humans may help dogs during surgery
items.summary: Dr. Jun-Yan Sek, a small-animal surgical registrar at JCUVet, lecturer at James Cook University and JCU veterinary alumnus, led a study investigating the use of xylometazoline hydrochloride during surgery.

items.title: Amazon study reveals the best strategies for protecting biodiversity and carbon

items.title: Administrative assistance and advocacy help Mumbai communities get essential services
items.summary: Access to clean drinking water is a basic human need, yet many residents struggle to obtain it. In Mumbai, India, one of the world's largest and most populous cities, hundreds of informal settlements housing millions of residents face barriers to securing government-provided water connections.

items.title: What's keeping schoolchildren from eating local foods?
items.summary: To get locally grown food onto a schoolchild's lunch tray, communities need supply chains that sort, process and package local farm products. They don't always exist.

items.title: Shoppers know fast fashion harms the environment but keep buying
items.summary: New RMIT University research suggests environmental awareness alone may not stop people from buying ultra-fast fashion, with price and convenience trumping sustainability concerns for shoppers.
